amplitude.normalization_decision: Do not apply per-file peak normalization; decoded floating-point PCM is not normalization and loudness may be informative.

provisional_recommendation.amplitude_normalization: do not apply per-file peak normalization
provisional_recommendation.padding: zero-pad deterministically, split between beginning and end
provisional_recommendation.risks: Energy trimming approximates boundaries and may remove low-energy speech; settings require review before application.
